task: Set up the dependencies for our image-resize microservice: write the requirements.txt (it uses fastapi, httpx, and pillow) and the Dockerfile RUN line that installs them.

constraints.text: every dependency line carries an exact == pin
constraints.why: an unpinned fastapi entry on 2026-06-14 pulled in a new pydantic major overnight and the deploy was down for four hours

checks.description: uses >= range instead of an exact pin

constraints.text: docker image installs run pip with --no-cache-dir
constraints.why: cached wheels pushed the image past the registry's 2 GB cap in 2026-04 and blocked the release train

constraints.text: the Dockerfile installs from the pin file (pip install -r requirements.txt), never by re-listing package names inline
constraints.why: inline names drifted from the pin file in 2025-12 and prod ran a different httpx than CI for two weeks

checks.description: Dockerfile does not install from requirements.txt
